question: What are the titles of games that have platforms in the market districts of Asia or the USA?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "platforms" AS SELECT "platform_id" AS "platform_id", "pn" AS "pn", "md" AS "md", "download_rank" AS "download_rank" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "games" AS SELECT "game_id" AS "game_id", "title" AS "title", "release_date" AS "release_date", "franchise" AS "franchise", "developers" AS "developers", "1" AS "1", "2" AS "2", "3" AS "3", "4" AS "4" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE platforms AS SELECT platform_id, pn, md, download_rank, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM platforms
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE games AS SELECT game_id, title, release_date, franchise, developers, "1", "2", "3", "4", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS columns FROM games

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_platforms AS (
  SELECT pn AS platform_name
  FROM platforms
  WHERE md IN ('Asia','USA')
),
paired AS (
  SELECT g.title, tp.platform_name
  FROM games g
  JOIN target_platforms tp ON TRUE
)
SELECT DISTINCT title
FROM paired
ORDER BY title
LIMIT 20;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT title, 'Assumed available on platforms in Asia/USA (no explicit linkage in data)' AS note
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.title
  FROM games g
  WHERE g.title IS NOT NULL
) t
ORDER BY title
LIMIT 10;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_platforms AS (
  SELECT pn AS platform_name, md
  FROM platforms
  WHERE md IN ('Asia','USA')
), sample_titles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT title FROM games WHERE title IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title LIMIT 10
)
SELECT st.title,
       list_agg(tp.platform_name || ' (' || tp.md || ')', ', ') AS candidate_platforms,
       'No explicit game-to-platform mapping present; titles shown are not definitively tied to listed platforms.' AS note
FROM sample_titles st
CROSS JOIN target_platforms tp
GROUP BY st.title
ORDER BY st.title;
S:
# Produce a small, transparent preview: platforms in Asia/USA and a sample of distinct titles, noting lack of linkage.
result_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_platforms AS (
  SELECT pn AS platform_name, md
  FROM platforms
  WHERE md IN ('Asia','USA')
), sample_titles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT title FROM games WHERE title IS NOT NULL ORDER BY title LIMIT 10
)
SELECT st.title,
       list_agg(tp.platform_name || ' (' || tp.md || ')', ', ') AS candidate_platforms,
       'No explicit game-to-platform mapping present; titles shown are not definitively tied to listed platforms.' AS note
FROM sample_titles st
CROSS JOIN target_platforms tp
GROUP BY st.title
ORDER BY st.title;
""")
